I think the idea there was just to simplify the EIP by making sure there's no negative numbers in the spec I suppose we could remove the restriction.... though if we want to *actually* support child-pays-for-parent that would be a larger ask for the ethereum network as a whole Because I don't think it supports that now > Hi. I'm Kubuxu, one of the devs of Filecoin. As you probably heard we've implemented our version of EIP1559 in Filecoin. <@!96996691282001920> Any learnings from the implementation so far? One you caught right after we've implemented and before we were able to communicate it to you all, it is that minimum basefee needs to be greater than 0 (or 1, we've set it to 100). Other than that it works quite well. Our capacity is variable due to tipset system which requires some changes and adds noise.

excerpts.author: .vbuterin
excerpts.content: > It seemed like a nice mechanic, allowing higher nonce messages cover too low FeeCap of earlier ones.

excerpts.author: .vbuterin
excerpts.content: I think the idea there was just to simplify the EIP by making sure there's no negative numbers in the spec

excerpts.author: .vbuterin
excerpts.content: I suppose we could remove the restriction.... though if we want to *actually* support child-pays-for-parent that would be a larger ask for the ethereum network as a whole

excerpts.author: .vbuterin
excerpts.content: Because I don't think it supports that now

excerpts.author: .vbuterin
excerpts.content:
> Hi. I'm Kubuxu, one of the devs of Filecoin. As you probably heard we've implemented our version of EIP1559 in Filecoin.
<@!96996691282001920> Any learnings from the implementation so far?

excerpts.author: kubuxu
excerpts.content:
One you caught right after we've implemented and before we were able to communicate it to you all, it is that minimum basefee needs to be greater than 0 (or 1, we've set it to 100).
Other than that it works quite well. Our capacity is variable due to tipset system which requires some changes and adds noise.
